title: The Answer Written in the Margin
fact_notes: オリジナル教材。一般的な考え方と架空例を用いた文章であり、実在の人物、調査、実験、法令、技術運用手順ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A student preparing for a school examination borrows a book from a classmate who used it during the previous year.
sentences.ja: 学校試験の準備をする生徒が前年使った級友から本を借りる。

sentences.en: The student discovers several handwritten notes in the margins, including explanations of difficult concepts and possible answers to practice questions.
sentences.ja: 余白に難しい概念の説明や練習問題の答え候補を含む手書きメモをいくつも発見する。

sentences.en: The notes are useful, and the student considers sharing photographs of the marked pages with other members of the class.
sentences.ja: メモは役立ち、生徒は書き込みページの写真を他の級友と共有することを考える。

sentences.en: Before doing so, however, she wonders whether permission to borrow the book also includes permission to distribute the notes that someone else created.
sentences.ja: しかしそうする前に本を借りる許可に他者が作ったメモを配布する許可も含まれるか疑問を持つ。

sentences.en: Her classmate explains that he is happy for her to use the notes while studying.
sentences.ja: 級友は彼女が学習中メモを使うことを喜んでいると説明する。

sentences.en: He nevertheless feels uncomfortable about having his original explanations circulated to a larger group without an opportunity to check them.
sentences.ja: それでも確認の機会なく元の説明がより大きな集団に広まることには抵抗を感じる。

sentences.en: Some of the notes were written when he was still trying to understand the material, and they contain personal abbreviations whose meanings may not be clear to other readers.
sentences.ja: 一部のメモはまだ内容を理解しようとしていた時に書かれ、他の読者には意味が明確でない個人的略記を含む。

sentences.en: The two students distinguish the usefulness of the notes for a particular person from their suitability as a resource intended for general distribution.
sentences.ja: 二人は特定の人へのメモの有用性と一般配布用資源としての適切さを区別する。

sentences.en: They consider preparing a new set of study materials together rather than distributing photographs of the original pages.
sentences.ja: 元ページの写真を配布せず共同で新しい学習教材を用意することを考える。

sentences.en: The classmate can identify explanations that he is willing to share, while the borrower can suggest changes that would make the material easier for other students to understand.
sentences.ja: 級友は共有したい説明を特定でき、借り手は他生徒が理解しやすくする変更を提案できる。

sentences.en: They also plan to indicate which explanations they have not yet verified against reliable learning resources.
sentences.ja: 信頼できる学習資料と照らしてまだ検証していない説明を示す計画も立てる。

sentences.en: The arrangement acknowledges the contribution of both students without assuming that access to an object automatically authorizes every possible use of its contents.
sentences.ja: 仕組みは物へのアクセスが中身の全用途を自動許可すると想定せず双方の貢献を認める。

sentences.en: This fictional discussion does not establish the legal rules that apply to copying actual books or distributing educational materials.
sentences.ja: この架空議論は実書籍の複製や教材配布に適用される法的規則を確定しない。

sentences.en: Instead, it illustrates an ethical distinction between receiving assistance for a particular purpose and acquiring control over information that someone provided.
sentences.ja: 代わりに特定目的の援助を受けることと提供情報の管理権を獲得することの倫理的区別を示す。

sentences.en: A decision to share another person's work can affect the way that work is understood by people for whom it was not originally intended.
sentences.ja: 他者の作業を共有する判断は当初対象でなかった人々にそれがどう理解されるかに影響し得る。

sentences.en: Asking about the intended scope of permission may therefore reveal concerns that were invisible when the original offer was made.
sentences.ja: そこで許可の想定範囲を尋ねると当初申し出時に見えなかった懸念が明らかになる場合がある。

sentences.en: Sharing knowledge is valuable, but the conditions under which it is shared can matter to the people who contributed it.
sentences.ja: 知識共有は有益だが共有条件は貢献者にとって重要になり得る。

sentences.en: The students discover that they can expand access to useful explanations through cooperation rather than treating permission as an unlimited resource.
sentences.ja: 生徒は許可を無制限資源と扱わず協力で有用説明へのアクセスを広げられると知る。

sentences.en: Responsible generosity includes attention to the expectations and responsibilities of the people involved.
sentences.ja: 責任ある寛大さには関係者の期待と責任への注意が含まれる。

sentences.en: The small answer in the margin becomes a much larger question about the meaning of sharing.
sentences.ja: 余白の小さな答えは共有の意味についてのより大きな問いになる。

vocabulary.definition: short forms of words or phrases
quality of being right for a purpose
things one is expected to do

options: A complete set of official exam answers.

questions.prompt: What does she question before sharing pictures?
options: Whether the book has any pages.
Whether she can read any words.
Whether every classmate owns a camera.
Whether permission to borrow includes permission to distribute the notes.

questions.prompt: Why is the owner uncomfortable about broad circulation?
options: He does not want the borrower to study.
He has not had an opportunity to check the explanations.
He intends to sell the book immediately.
questions.explanation_ja: 説明の確認機会がない。

questions.prompt: Why might notes useful to one person confuse others?
options: They contain personal abbreviations and tentative explanations.
Every note is written in a different language.
All readers necessarily interpret information identically.
questions.explanation_ja: 個人的略記や途中理解。

options: Sending all original pictures without asking.
The students want every explanation to look certain.
Readers should know which claims still require checking.
All learning resources prove identical conclusions.

questions.prompt: What does the discussion not establish?
options: Actual legal requirements for copying and distribution.
The existence of an ethical issue.
questions.explanation_ja: 法的要件は確定しない。

questions.prompt: Why ask about the scope of permission?
options: It guarantees that every possible use is permitted.
It automatically transfers ownership of the book.
It may reveal expectations not considered in the initial offer.
questions.explanation_ja: 見えていなかった懸念。

questions.prompt: Which statement best expresses the argument?
options: Responsible sharing involves respecting the purpose and expectations of those who provided information.
Borrowing an item gives unlimited permission to distribute its contents.
Useful information should never be shared.
Permission has no relevance when a person means well.
questions.explanation_ja: 提供者の期待と共有目的。

paraphrases.source: Before doing so, however, she wonders whether permission to borrow the book also includes permission to distribute the notes that someone else created.
paraphrases.rewrite: She questions if borrowing permission also permits sharing the notes.

paraphrases.source: Some of the notes were written when he was still trying to understand the material, and they contain personal abbreviations whose meanings may not be clear to other readers.
paraphrases.rewrite: Some personal abbreviations could be unclear to other readers.

paraphrases.source: The classmate can identify explanations that he is willing to share, while the borrower can suggest changes that would make the material easier for other students to understand.
paraphrases.rewrite: Both students contribute: the owner selects notes and the borrower improves clarity.

paraphrases.source: The students discover that they can expand access to useful explanations through cooperation rather than treating permission as an unlimited resource.
paraphrases.rewrite: Cooperation can expand access without assuming permission is unrestricted.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 無制限の許可とみなさない。

discourse.role_ja: 個別利用と広範配布の差。
元の写真ではなく新教材。
法律判断ではなく倫理的区別。

cloze.explanation_ja: 検証されていない説明。
